description: This Kotlin source file defines data structures, enums, and utility functions related to notification forwarding policies within an Android app. It includes configuration for package filtering modes, quiet hours, rate limiting, and methods for checking rules based on current time and policy settings.

classes.name: NotificationForwardingPolicy
classes.description: Data class encapsulating notification forwarding settings including filtering mode, package list, quiet hours, and rate limits.

classes.name: NotificationBurstLimiter
classes.description: Class implementing rate limiting logic for notification bursts within a time window.

methods.name: NotificationPackageFilterMode.fromRawValue
methods.description: Parses a raw string and returns the corresponding filter mode; defaults to Blocklist.

methods.name: NotificationForwardingPolicy.allowsPackage
methods.description: Checks if a package is allowed based on the current filter mode.

methods.name: NotificationForwardingPolicy.isWithinQuietHours
methods.description: Checks if the current time (or specified epoch) is within designated quiet hours.

methods.name: normalizeLocalHourMinute
methods.description: Normalizes a raw time string to HH:MM format, returning null if invalid.

methods.name: parseLocalHourMinute
methods.description: Converts a time string to total minutes past midnight.

methods.name: NotificationBurstLimiter.allow
methods.description: Determines if a new event is allowed based on rate limits within a rolling 60-second window.
